audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer sells the lane as Poppy-favoured from level 3 while the level chart and the audited mirror both give Karma the early game.
audit.why: Karma's Inner Flame is 950 range against Poppy's 475-range Heroic Charge and 430-range Q; Poppy has no answer to poke until she pins Karma to terrain.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 to Karma, Levels 4-5 to Skill, matching the karma__poppy audit; Poppy takes over at first item.

audit.why: spikes[] already names levels 2-3, level 6, first item and Karma's Mantra-Q window; all four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1].why tells the player to hold W to delete Karma's dash. Karma has no dash anywhere in her kit — Inspire (E) is a shield plus raw move speed, which Steadfast Presence does not stop.
audit.why: Riot's text for Inspire: shield and move speed, no dash flag. Steadfast Presence only stops dashes, so it does nothing to her disengage.
audit.corrected: Stated that Karma has no dash for W to catch, and that Focused Resolve's root cancels Keeper's Verdict's channel (flagged channel/interruptible in the kit). Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at all ranks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals Karma, and no itemization line mentions Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Riot's W Mantra Bonus text: 'healing herself and extending the root duration.'
audit.corrected: Thornmail line now names its Grievous Wounds against the Mantra-W heal.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: W stops dashes; Karma has none — Inspire is pure move speed. Her 950-range Inner Flame outranges you, so she owns level 2.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Inspire's shield and speed slip your 475-range E. Keep the wave your side so she must step near terrain.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Focused Resolve's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Skill window: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s — engage inside it, since its root also cancels your Keeper's Verdict channel.

edits.before: Her RQ scales with ranks while your flat damage doesn't, so 4-5 stays hers as she chips you and you farm Q on the wave.
edits.after: By 4-5 it is a skill lane: her RQ poke still scales, but Q's max-HP tick farms the wave and one wall-stun flips the trade.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow engine), then Thornmail / Frozen Heart; boots Mercury's Treads.
edits.after: Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet, then Thornmail — its Grievous Wounds cuts her Mantra-W heal; boots Mercury's Treads.

notes: The full layer refers to Karma as 'him/his' in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull[0].d/[1].d and several report entries — Karma is female, and the content layer already uses 'she'. Only the strings I edited were fixed; the rest need a champion-level pronoun pass outside this proposal. Also: dosFull[2] is titled 'W his dash mid-flight' with a description about baiting Focused Resolve — both the title and the pairing are wrong (Karma has no dash), but rewriting the title within the length band would leave it vague, so it is flagged here rather than guessed at.
